items.bold: ARAGHCHI MEETS PUTIN TODAY IN ST PETERSBURG — Russia as guarantor confirmed.
items.text: IRNA, ISNA, and CNN (41 minutes ago) confirmed: Araghchi departed Islamabad Sunday night and is heading to St Petersburg, Russia (not Moscow city — IRNA specifically said St Petersburg). He will meet President Vladimir Putin today (Monday) and "consult with Russian officials on the latest status of the negotiations, the ceasefire and surrounding developments." Iran International (29 min ago) confirmed the same. This is the most significant diplomatic meeting of the week: Russia as guarantor country is a potential bridge for Iran's security guarantee demand — the key unresolved issue alongside Hormuz and nuclear. If Putin signals Russia will guarantee Iran's post-deal security: it removes one of Iran's core objections to a nuclear deal framework.

items.bold: ARAGHCHI left Islamabad — two visits in 48 hours concluded. Thanks to Pakistan. Questions US seriousness.
items.text: CNN confirmed: Araghchi's departure from Islamabad "marks the end of two visits to Pakistan in 48 hours, as hopes for further face-to-face US-Iranian talks dissipated." Iranian Ambassador to Pakistan Reza Amiri Moghadam thanked Pakistani leadership for "their tireless efforts" to end the war. Araghchi himself posted on X: "it's not clear if Washington is truly serious about diplomacy" — after Trump cancelled his envoys' trip. Iran International: Iran has loaded 4.6 million barrels at export terminals despite the blockade, with 4 million more appearing to have crossed the blockade line (TankerTrackers.com satellite data). This suggests the US blockade is leaking via the shadow fleet — reducing the acute economic pressure somewhat.

items.bold: IRAN + OMAN as "only littoral states" — discussed Hormuz safe transit. Trump OPPOSES toll mechanism.
items.text: Araghchi posted on X after Oman meeting: Iran and Oman, "as the only littoral states of the Strait of Hormuz, discussed ways to ensure safe transit to the benefit of all dear neighbors and the world." UK House of Commons Library (updated 10 hours ago) confirmed: "Trump has also opposed Iranian attempts to charge tolls for vessels to use the strait." Iran's FM Araghchi has said "we intend to devise a new arrangement to ensure secure maritime traffic through the waterway." The gap: Iran insisting on a Hormuz toll arrangement; Trump explicitly opposing it. This is not merely a temporary access dispute — it is a permanent sovereignty question. Oman's response to Iran's toll mechanism request is not yet known.

items.bold: TRUMP Sunday: "Call us. War will end very soon. US will be victorious." Phone-first US stance.
items.text: CNN confirmed: Trump on Sunday defended his decision to cancel envoys' Pakistan trip — "If they want to talk, they can come to us, or they can call us. You know, there is a telephone." Trump told Fox News: "we're not sending people to travel 18 hours to meet." Trump added the war would "come to an end very soon" and reiterated the US is "going to be very victorious." CBS News confirmed the same comments. Neither Trump nor any White House official scheduled a new envoy trip to the region. The US position is now: Iran must initiate contact (by phone), submit a unified proposal, and come to the table before any new in-person talks. This is a fundamentally passive US posture that puts all initiative on Iran.

items.bold: SHADOW FLEET STILL MOVING — Iran loaded 4.6M barrels despite blockade. Blockade leaking.
items.text: Iran International (29 min ago) citing TankerTrackers.com satellite analysis: Iran has loaded at least 4.6 million barrels of crude oil at export terminals despite the ongoing US naval blockade, with an additional 4 million barrels appearing to have crossed the blockade line. This significantly tempers the Bessent "wells shuttering in 2-3 days" warning from last week. Iran retains SOME ability to continue oil exports through its shadow fleet — sanctioned tankers, dark ship-to-ship transfers, false flag operations. The US has been intercepting shadow fleet vessels (Touska, Tifani, Sevan, ex-Phonix) but cannot intercept every vessel. The 4M barrels crossing the blockade line suggest Iran's economic pain is real but not as acute as Washington claimed.

items.bold: CHEVRON CEO: Energy system "lost incredible flexibility." Lebanon: 16th Israeli soldier killed Sunday.
items.text: CBS News confirmed: Chevron Chairman and CEO Mike Wirth told Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan that the global energy system "has lost an incredible amount of flexibility" since the start of the Iran war. This is a structural energy market statement — even if Hormuz reopens, the supply chain damage from 8+ weeks of disruption will take 6-12 months to fully recover. The mine-clearing timeline (up to 6 months per US officials) alone prevents rapid normalisation. Separately: CNN confirmed an Israeli soldier was killed in southern Lebanon Sunday — bringing total Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon since the war began to 16. Lebanon death toll: 2,496+ since March 2. Lebanon ceasefire fragility remains a complication for any Hormuz deal.

assessment.headline: DAY 59, 7AM MON: ARAGHCHI MEETS PUTIN TODAY (St Petersburg). SHADOW FLEET LEAKING — 4.6M bbls loaded despite blockade. Iran + Oman as "only littoral states" — toll mechanism vs Trump opposition. Brent $99-103. India markets open 9:15 AM.
assessment.body:
Monday 7 AM IST. Day 59. Two key developments reframe the West Asia War this morning.

THE PUTIN MEETING — THE DAY'S KEY DIPLOMATIC EVENT
• Araghchi left Islamabad Sunday night heading to St Petersburg
• Will meet President Putin today (IRNA/ISNA/CNN confirmed)
• Will "consult on negotiations, ceasefire and surrounding developments"
• Russia as guarantor is the bridge for Iran's security guarantee demand
• If Putin signals Russia will guarantee Iran's post-deal security: removes a core Iranian objection
• Voice of Emirates: meeting aimed at "formulating a joint position" and signalling strategic depth
• Watch for: any Lavrov-Araghchi/Putin-Araghchi readout on Russia's guarantor role

THE SHADOW FLEET REVELATION — BLOCKADE IS LEAKING
• TankerTrackers.com satellite data (Iran International, 29 min ago): Iran loaded 4.6M bbls despite blockade
• Additional 4M barrels may have crossed the blockade line
• This tempers Bessent's "wells shuttering in 2-3 days" claim significantly
• Iran's economic pain: real but not as acute as Washington projected
• US is intercepting vessels (37 total redirected) but cannot stop every shadow tanker
• For India: Brent cap is lower than pure-blockade scenario suggests
• For oil markets: blockade effectiveness is ~70%, not 100%

THE HORMUZ SOVEREIGNTY GAP — WIDER THAN EXPECTED
• Araghchi on X: Iran and Oman as "only littoral states" discussed Hormuz safe transit
• UK House of Commons Library: Trump explicitly opposes Iran's toll mechanism
• Iran wants: institutionalised Hormuz control with toll revenue
• Trump wants: unconditional free navigation
• Oman's response to hosting the toll mechanism: unknown
• This is a permanent sovereignty question — more difficult than the nuclear deal

THE DIPLOMATIC ARCHITECTURE AT DAY 59
• Iran: Araghchi has visited Pakistan (twice), Oman (Sultan meeting), Qatar+Saudi (calls), Moscow (Putin today)
• US: Trump cancelled Islamabad trip, phone-first, no new envoy trip planned
• Pakistan: mediating with tireless effort — infrastructure on standby
• Russia: meeting today — guarantor role being finalised
• Oman: toll mechanism ask pending response
• Lebanon: fragile — 2,496+ killed, Israel striking "vigorously"

INDIA MONDAY OPEN — 9:15 AM IST
• Brent ~$99-103: shadow fleet + talks-alive easing from $107 peak
• Nifty 23,897 prev close (below 24,000), Sensex 76,681
• Infosys Q4 PAT +21% beat residual positive — IT sector possible recovery
• Shadow fleet data = Brent cap = reduced OMC hike urgency
• 45% Putin positive → Nifty 24,000-24,300
• 40% stalemate → Nifty 23,700-24,000
• 15% incident → below 23,500

VERDICT: The two new facts that matter most this morning: (1) The shadow fleet is leaking the US blockade — Iran has loaded 8.6M barrels despite 37 ships being redirected. The blockade is effective but not airtight. This changes the timeline for economic collapse of Iran's oil sector. (2) Araghchi is meeting Putin today in St Petersburg. Russia's role as a security guarantor is the missing piece in any deal architecture — if Putin agrees to guarantee Iran's security post-deal, the nuclear concession becomes politically possible inside Iran. India wakes up to Brent at $99-103 (easing), diplomacy alive (Putin meeting), and its markets opening in 2 hours to price all of this.
